sub_indicators.label: Interoperability of health systems
sub_indicators.subject: dpi.exchange
sub_indicators.text: Interoperability of health systems: interoperability of health systems
sub_indicators.norm_short: Africa CDC's health information exchange guidelines and Smart Africa's digital health blueprint ask for a national exchange policy, common standards and identifiers, then exchanges in service across the health system.
criteria: A source from the past three years says the country's health systems do not exchange data.
An exchange between health systems is contracted, being built or piloted, or a health information exchange is being set up.
Two or more health systems exchange data in routine use, such as the HMIS with patient records, a laboratory or supply-chain system.
Three or more health systems exchange data, or a national health information exchange is in service.
Patient records are linked across systems through the national ID or a national unique health identifier.

aspects.name: Patients matched by a national identifier
